# Task P7-03b: Prowlarr search and Gazelle-direct indexers

**Phase:** 7 · **Depends on:** P7-03a · **Suggested tier:** cheap worker (T2) · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal
Two more indexer types beside Torznab/Newznab (ADR-0009, DECISIONS build session 8 #2): **Prowlarr** — one row that searches every indexer Prowlarr has through its own `/api/v1/search`, so a user with Prowlarr adds one thing; and **Gazelle** — a direct client for Gazelle trackers (Redacted, Orpheus) with the user's API key, which can see the file list of each torrent before anything is downloaded.

## Deliverables
In `src/Wondarr.Sources.Torznab/Indexers/`:

1. `ProwlarrIndexerType.cs` — `IIndexerType` with `Type` `prowlarr`, `Protocol` `null` (the row chooses torrent or usenet; P7-01 enforces it); fields `url` (text, required, e.g. `http://prowlarr:9696`), `apiKey` (password, secret), `indexerIds` (text, optional, comma-separated Prowlarr indexer ids; empty means all), `categories` (text, default `3000`). `TestAsync`: `GET {url}/api/v1/system/status` with header `X-Api-Key` → success with nothing else needed; 401 → "Prowlarr refused the API key".
2. `ProwlarrSearchClient.cs` — `IIndexerClient` for `prowlarr`: `GET {url}/api/v1/search?query={artist album}&type=search&categories=3000&indexerIds=1&indexerIds=2&limit=100` with `X-Api-Key` (repeat `categories` and `indexerIds` per value, as Prowlarr's API binds arrays). The JSON answer is an array of releases; map `guid` (→ `ReleaseId`), `title`, `size`, `downloadUrl`, `magnetUrl`, `infoHash`, `seeders`, `leechers` (→ `Peers` = seeders + leechers), `grabs`, `protocol` (`"torrent"`/`"usenet"`), `indexerId`, `indexer`, `publishDate`, `infoUrl`, `categories[].id` into `IndexerRelease`, keeping only releases of the row's protocol. `DownloadAsync` fetches `downloadUrl` (Prowlarr proxies it; a redirect to `magnet:` gives the magnet) with the same 10 MiB limit as P7-03a.
3. `GazelleIndexerType.cs` — `Type` `gazelle`, protocol Torrent; fields `url` (text, required, e.g. `https://redacted.sh`), `apiKey` (password, secret; sent as the `Authorization` header value), `useFreeleechTokens` (checkbox, default false, advanced). `TestAsync`: `GET {url}/ajax.php?action=index` → `{"status":"success"}`; anything else reports the `error` text.
4. `GazelleClient.cs` — `IIndexerClient` for `gazelle`, **ported from Lidarr** `GazelleRequestGenerator.cs`, `GazelleParser.cs`, `GazelleApi.cs` (reference copies in `docs/build/tasks/ref/lidarr/`) and extended:
   - search: `ajax.php?action=browse&artistname={artist}&groupname={album}&order_by=time&order_way=desc` (as Lidarr), mapped to one `IndexerRelease` per torrent of each group (title built as Lidarr does: `artist - group (year) [format encoding media]`, `ReleaseId` `gazelle-{torrentId}`, `Seeders`, `Size`, `InfoUrl` `torrents.php?id={groupId}&torrentid={torrentId}`, `DownloadUrl` `ajax.php?action=download&id={torrentId}` plus `&usetoken=1` when the setting is on and the torrent is not already freeleech);
   - file list: for the five best-seeded torrents of the answer, `ajax.php?action=torrent&id={torrentId}` → `torrent.fileList`, a string `name{{{size}}}|||name{{{size}}}` (HTML entities decoded), into `IndexerRelease.FileList` (`Index` in order, `Path` = `torrent.filePath` + `/` + name when `filePath` is not empty, `Size`);
   - rate limit: at most 5 requests per 10 s per row (a `SemaphoreSlim` + timestamps, or `System.Threading.RateLimiting`'s `SlidingWindowRateLimiter`, injected `TimeProvider` so the test needs no real waiting);
   - `DownloadAsync` sends the `Authorization` header (never a query key), 10 MiB limit.
5. Registration of the types and clients in `src/Wondarr.Sources.Torznab/ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs`; `NOTICE.md` rows and `Ported from` headers for the Gazelle ports.

Tests in `tests/Wondarr.Sources.Tests/Torznab/Indexers/` with fixtures `tests/fixtures/torznab/prowlarr-search.json` (one torrent with a magnet, one with a `.torrent` link, one usenet release), `gazelle-browse.json` (two groups, three torrents), `gazelle-torrent.json` (a `fileList` with an `&amp;` in a name and a `filePath`), `gazelle-failure.json` (`{"status":"failure","error":"bad credentials"}`):
- the Prowlarr URL (repeated array parameters; the key only in the header), the protocol filter, every mapped field;
- the Gazelle browse → releases mapping, the five-best file-list fetch (the sixth is not fetched), the `fileList` split and decoding, `usetoken=1` only when asked and not freeleech;
- the rate limit (six searches' requests are spread over two windows, using a fake `TimeProvider`);
- `TestAsync` success and failure for both types; no API key in any log line or error.
